title: 第0017章武道集训血色试炼场第0018章度假区的暗流

;;
凰溪岛的晨雾还未散尽，贾黑米站在武道馆后院的训练场上，掌心攥着一张泛黄的纸条——那是叶利西今早塞给他的集训邀请函，墨迹未干的“特训”二字下压着枚青铜钥匙，钥匙齿痕里还沾着暗红锈迹。
“血色试炼场？”他盯着纸条上的地点，喉结动了动。这是凰溪岛最古老的武道训练场，据说曾是上一代武道高考的考场，后来因“意外”被封禁，如今只有武道世家核心子弟能通过特殊渠道进入。而叶利西的批注简短得可怕：“今日午时，钥匙开路，活下来。”
一、血色入场券
午时的阳光像把烧红的刀，劈开试炼场外缠绕的铁链。贾黑米将青铜钥匙插入门锁的瞬间，整座铁门突然泛起血色纹路，那些纹路如同活物般蠕动，顺着他的手腕攀上脖颈。他下意识要后退，却听见叶利西的声音在耳边炸响：“别动！这是‘血契’，认主呢。”
话音未落，铁门轰然洞开。腥风扑面而来，贾黑米眯起眼——试炼场内不是他想象的破败，反而灯火通明，中央擂台悬浮在半空，四周环绕着十二座血色晶柱，每根柱子上都刻满扭曲符文。更诡异的是，擂台下方堆着成山的异兽骸骨，骨缝间还渗着暗红液体，像是刚被啃食过。
“新来的？”一道戏谑的声音从背后传来。贾黑米转身，看见三个穿黑色武道服的青年正倚在门框上，为首的寸头男嘴角挂着疤，手里抛着枚带血的铜币，“叶老头又塞人进来送死？上次那个被掏了心肝的，哭得可惨了。”
贾黑米没接话，目光落在寸头男腰间的玉牌上——那是武道世家“赵家”的标识。他想起叶利西提过，赵家是凰溪岛三大武道世家之一，专出“血修”，靠吞噬异兽精血提升气血，手段狠辣。
“哑巴？”寸头男向前一步，铜币突然“叮”地弹起，化作一道血影射向贾黑米眉心！贾黑米瞳孔骤缩，本能地侧身，却见那铜币在半空炸开，化作血雾将他笼罩。
“低语侵蚀...”他心头一凛，耳边瞬间响起无数呢喃：“跪下...你配不上武道...气血孱弱的废物...”这些声音像针，顺着耳膜往脑子里扎，他双腿发软，几乎要跪倒。
“破！”关键时刻，他咬破舌尖，血腥味混着剧痛冲散杂念，同时调动「心灵破障」天赋，金色光芒从眼底迸发，血雾“滋啦”一声被蒸发殆尽。
寸头男脸色微变：“有点东西？不过这才刚开始呢。”他抬手一挥，试炼场四周的晶柱突然亮起，十二道血光汇聚成网，将贾黑米困在中央。地面开始震动，骸骨堆里爬出数十具半腐烂的异兽尸体，它们眼眶空洞，却精准地锁定了贾黑米的位置。
二、试炼场的规则
“血色试炼场，规则很简单。”寸头男的声音从血网外传来，“活过三轮。第一轮，异兽群；第二轮，武道傀儡；第三轮...”他故意拖长音调，“你自己体会。”
贾黑米背贴着血网，掌心渗出冷汗。第一轮的异兽群已经逼近，最前头的是三头“血牙狼”，这种异兽本就以速度见长，此刻被血光强化后，利爪划过空气的声响都带着破风声。
“不能硬拼。”他快速扫视四周，发现血网虽密，但晶柱底部有道缝隙。他侧身躲过第一头狼的扑击，顺势滚向最近的晶柱，手指抠住缝隙用力一掰——“咔嚓”一声，晶柱竟被他掰下块棱角！
“果然。”他眼睛一亮。这些晶柱是“血晶”，蕴含精纯气血，但质地脆硬。他攥紧血晶，气血灌入其中，血晶瞬间泛起红光，像块烧红的炭。
“去！”他甩出血晶，正中第二头狼的额头。血晶“轰”地炸开，狼头被炸得粉碎，血雾喷溅到第三头狼身上，那狼突然发出凄厉嚎叫，身体膨胀成球，竟是自爆了！
爆炸的冲击波掀飞了血网一角，贾黑米趁机冲出包围，还没站稳，就听见头顶传来破空声。他抬头，看见擂台上不知何时多了个木偶——不，是武道傀儡！它手持双刀，刀身刻满符文，一刀劈下，空气都被劈出裂痕。
“第二轮开始了。”寸头男的声音带着笑意。

贾黑米翻身躲过刀锋，傀儡的刀却像有生命般追着他砍。他边跑边观察，发现傀儡的关节处有道细缝，缝里透着蓝光——那是序列能量的核心！
“得毁了它。”他摸向腰间，那里藏着叶利西给他的“心灵针”，针身刻满净化符文，是专门对付被侵蚀者的。但傀儡不是人，心灵针有用吗？
没时间犹豫了。傀儡的双刀已经交叉劈下，刀风形成十字斩，将他退路全部封死。贾黑米咬紧牙关，侧身让过要害，左肩被刀锋划开道血口，同时右手将心灵针刺入傀儡的关节缝！
“滋——”蓝光与金光碰撞，傀儡的动作突然僵住，刀上的符文开始褪色。贾黑米趁机后退，看见傀儡体内涌出大量黑雾——那是被压制的邪神低语！
“原来傀儡也被侵蚀了。”他恍然大悟。难怪第二轮和第一轮衔接得这么紧，邪神在利用傀儡持续释放低语，消耗他的精神力。
三、隐藏的第三轮
傀儡倒下的瞬间，试炼场突然安静下来。血网消失了，异兽骸骨也不见了，只有中央擂台还悬浮着，散发着诡异的红光。
“恭喜你，活过两轮。”寸头男从阴影里走出，这次他的表情没了戏谑，反而带着几分凝重，“不过第三轮...是‘心魔’。”
贾黑米心头一沉。心魔试炼，这是武道高考最残酷的项目之一，考生要直面内心最深的恐惧或执念，一旦被心魔吞噬，轻则武道根基尽毁，重则当场死亡。

The morning fog on Huangxi Island has not yet cleared. Jia Heimi stood on the training ground in the backyard of the martial arts gym, holding a yellowed piece of paper in his palm - it was the training invitation letter that Ye Lixi thrust into him this morning. Under the word "Special Training" that was still inked, there was a bronze key, with dark red rust stains on the teeth of the key.
"The Bloody Trial Ground?" He stared at the location on the note, his Adam's apple twitching. This is the oldest martial arts training ground on Huangxi Island. It is said that it was once the examination room for the martial arts college entrance examination of the previous generation. It was later banned due to an "accident". Now only core children of martial arts families can enter through special channels. Ye Lixi's comment was terrifyingly brief: "Today at noon, the key will open the way. Survive."
1. Bloody Admission Ticket
The midday sun was like a red-hot knife, splitting the iron chains wrapped around the trial site. The moment Jiahemi inserted the bronze key into the door lock, the entire iron door suddenly glowed with bloody lines. Those lines squirmed like living creatures, climbing up his wrists and up his neck. He subconsciously wanted to retreat, but he heard Ye Lixi's voice blasting in his ears: "Don't move! This is the 'blood contract', you have to recognize the owner."
Before he finished speaking, the iron door burst open. Jia Heimi narrowed his eyes as a fishy wind blew towards his face - the trial ground was not as dilapidated as he imagined, but instead brightly lit. The central arena was suspended in mid-air, surrounded by twelve blood-colored crystal pillars, each of which was engraved with twisted runes. What's even weirder is that there are mountains of bones of alien beasts piled under the ring, with dark red liquid seeping between the bones, as if they had just been eaten.
"New here?" A joking voice came from behind. Jia Heimi turned around and saw three young men in black martial arts uniforms leaning against the door frame. The leader, a short-haired man with a scar on the corner of his mouth, was throwing a bloody copper coin in his hand. "Old Man Ye forced someone in to die again? The one who had his heart and liver ripped out last time was crying miserably."
Jia Heimi didn't answer, his eyes fell on the jade plaque around the short-haired man's waist - it was the logo of the "Zhao Family" of the martial arts family. He remembered that Ye Lixi had mentioned that the Zhao family was one of the three major martial arts families on Huangxi Island. They specialized in "blood cultivation" and relied on devouring the essence and blood of alien animals to increase their vitality and blood. Their methods were ruthless.
"Mute?" The short-haired man took a step forward, and the copper coin suddenly bounced up with a "ding", turning into a blood shadow and shooting towards Jia Heimi's eyebrows! Jia Heimi's pupils shrank suddenly and he instinctively turned sideways, only to see the copper coin explode in mid-air, turning into blood mist and covering him.
"Whispers corrode..." His heart trembled, and countless whispers suddenly sounded in his ears: "Kneel down... you are not worthy of martial arts... a waste with weak energy and blood..." These voices were like needles, piercing his eardrums into his brain. His legs became weak and he almost fell to his knees.
"Break!" At the critical moment, he bit the tip of his tongue. The smell of blood mixed with severe pain drove away distracting thoughts. At the same time, he mobilized his "Psychic Barrier Breaking" talent. Golden light burst out from his eyes, and the blood mist evaporated with a "sizzle".
The face of the short-haired man changed slightly: "Something? But this is just the beginning." He raised his hand and waved, and the crystal pillars around the trial field suddenly lit up, and twelve rays of blood converged into a net, trapping Jia Heimi in the center. The ground began to shake, and dozens of semi-rotted corpses of alien beasts crawled out of the pile of bones. Their eye sockets were hollow, but they accurately locked onto Jahimi's position.
2. Rules of the Proving Ground
"The rules of the Scarlet Trial Field are very simple." The short-haired man's voice came from outside the Blood Network, "Survive three rounds. The first round, the group of alien beasts; the second round, the martial arts puppets; the third round..." He deliberately prolonged his tone, "You can experience it yourself."
Jiahemi's back was pressed against the blood net, and cold sweat broke out on his palms. The first round of alien beasts were approaching. At the forefront were three "blood-toothed wolves". This alien beast was known for its speed. After being strengthened by the blood light, the sound of its sharp claws slicing through the air was like the sound of wind.
"You can't fight hard." He quickly glanced around and found that although the blood network was dense, there was a gap at the bottom of the crystal pillar. He turned sideways to avoid the attack of the first wolf, rolled towards the nearest crystal pillar, grabbed the gap with his fingers and broke it hard——With a "click", he actually broke off a corner of the crystal pillar!
"Sure enough." His eyes lit up. These crystal pillars are "blood crystals", which contain pure Qi and blood, but are brittle and hard in texture. He clenched the blood crystal tightly, pouring energy and blood into it. The blood crystal instantly glowed red, like a piece of red-hot coal.
"Go!" He threw the blood crystal and hit the second wolf in the forehead. The blood crystal exploded with a "bang", the wolf's head was blown to pieces, and the blood mist sprayed on the third wolf. The wolf suddenly let out a shrill howl, and its body expanded into a ball, and it actually self-destructed!
The shock wave of the explosion blew away a corner of the blood net. Jiahemi took the opportunity to rush out of the encirclement. Before he could stand still, he heard the sound of breaking through the air above his head. He looked up and saw that there was a puppet on the ring at some point - no, it was a martial arts puppet! It held two swords, the blades were engraved with runes, and when the sword struck down, the air was split into cracks.
"The second round has begun." The short-haired man said with a smile.
Jiahemi turned over to avoid the blade, but the puppet's knife chased and slashed at him as if it were alive. He observed as he ran and found a thin crack at the puppet's joints, with blue light shining through the crack - that was the core of the sequence energy!
"It has to be destroyed." He touched his waist, where he hid the "spiritual needle" given to him by Ye Lixi. The needle was engraved with purification runes and was designed to deal with the corrupted. But the puppet is not a person, is the psychic needle useful?
There was no time to hesitate. The puppet's two swords had crossed and struck down, and the wind of the swords formed a cross slash, blocking all his retreat routes. Jiahemi gritted his teeth, turned sideways to pass the vital part, and a bloody gash was cut on his left shoulder by the blade. At the same time, he inserted the spiritual needle into the puppet's joint seam with his right hand!
"Zi——" The blue light collided with the golden light, the puppet's movements suddenly froze, and the runes on the knife began to fade. Jia Heimi took the opportunity to retreat and saw a large amount of black mist pouring out of the puppet's body - that was the suppressed whisper of the evil god!
"It turns out that the puppet has also been eroded." He suddenly realized. No wonder the second round and the first round are so closely connected. The evil god is using the puppet to continuously release whispers and consume his mental power.
3. The hidden third wheel
The moment the puppet fell, the trial ground suddenly became quiet. The blood network disappeared, and the bones of the alien beasts disappeared. Only the central arena was still suspended, emitting a strange red light.
"Congratulations, you survived two rounds." The short-haired man walked out of the shadows. This time, his expression was no longer joking, but rather solemn. "But the third round... is the 'inner demon'."
Jiahemi's heart sank. The inner demon test is one of the most cruel events in the martial arts college entrance examination. Candidates have to face their deepest fears or obsessions. Once swallowed by the inner demon, the foundation of martial arts will be destroyed at best, or die on the spot at worst.
